symptom: ako/mxcli#1835 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1686, 11.12.4): `retrieve $L from Mod.Item where Name like 'A-%'` passed check and exec, then failed the build with CE0161. The reported second shape, `Status = Mod.ENUM_X.VALUE`, no longer reproduced: the writer already stores 'VALUE' and it builds clean on 11.12.2
cause: the MDL expression rule is shared with OQL and admits LIKE / NOT LIKE / BETWEEN / IN / MATCH, but visitor buildComparisonExpression returned only the left operand for them, so the constraint was stored as `[Name]` (and `where N between 1 and 5` as `[N]`); in a microflow expression `$s like 'A%'` was stored as `$s`. IS NULL / IS NOT NULL were kept as a BinaryExpr but nothing refused them
fix: the visitor keeps the comparison as written (SourceExpr over a BinaryExpr with the lowercased operator); check reports MDL091 (exec-enforced) naming the operator, CE0161 in a retrieve constraint and CE0117 in an expression, with the XPath/expression spelling of the same test
test: mdl/executor/xpath_oql_comparison_test.go — like/not like/between/in in a constraint, like in a declare, check and exec agreeing; controls starts-with, contains, >= and <=, a literal containing 'like', an enum key. Revert: every bad case got [] and the constraint serialized as "Name". Measured on mxbuild 11.12.2: [Name like 'A-%'], [Name not like …], [N between 1 and 5], [N in (1, 2)], [Name is null] CE0161; $s like / is null / in (…) CE0117; starts-with, not(contains()), >= and <=, = or =, = empty, Status = Mod.Enum.Value, startsWith() clean
insight: A check cannot see what the visitor never put in the AST: the report read as a missing rule, but the operator was gone before any rule ran, so the stored constraint differed from the script and describe printed the truncated form. When a grammar rule is shared with another language (here OQL), audit every alternative the visitor ignores — each one is a silent drop. describe's own XPath reader drops the same operators on the way out (a stored [Name like 'A-%'] describes as `where Name`)
